infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MealScanner needs access to your camera to scan and analyze meal images for nutritional information.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MealScanner needs access to your photo library to select meal images for nutritional analysis.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MealScanner needs access to your microphone for voice input to describe meals.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: MealScanner reads your active energy and steps to adjust your daily nutrition targets.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: MealScanner logs your meal calories and macros to your Apple Health history.
